description: This file implements the ScreenshotHandler class for capturing and saving screenshots from WebRTC video frames, including image encoding and frame handling logic.

classes.name: ScreenshotHandler
classes.description: Handles capturing and saving screenshots from WebRTC video frames.

methods.name: ScreenshotHandler::Screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot from a WebRTC display and saves it to the specified path, encoding the image based on file extension.

methods.name: ScreenshotHandler::OnFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming video frames for a specific display, setting the frame in the pending screenshot promise.
